svg.text: 10,000 sf Office - Central AHU with VAV / Fan-Powered Boxes
Ceiling plan at 9 ft AFF looking up. Ductwork centreline 11 ft 6 in AFF. Grid 25 ft. Scale 1 ft = 7 px.
Square with X = 24x24 supply diffuser. Square with bar = 24x24 plenum return grille.
AHU-1 8,500 cfm, 1,500 cfm OA. Primary air 8,000 cfm: 4 VAV + 8 FPB. 48 diffusers, 16 return grilles, 915.5 ft duct.
